confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, inexpensive and mid-range meals) rest on aggregator summaries from CityCost, WhereAndWhen, Expatistan and a Kota Bharu cafe price listing, with mixed dates; treat them as rough. Cocktail and wine rely on hotel and Kuala Lumpur benchmarks plus the local beer relationship, because I did not find a Malacca wine price. Wine was not searched; the sixth search was used for FX. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Malacca context. I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings. The FX value comes from a search summary attributing 0.6955 to the RBA as of 15 October 2026. I did not read the F11 table directly, and I excluded an unverified 16 October figure. The MYR-to-USD working rate used for conversion is about 4.1 ringgit per dollar, taken from the snippets, so anchors will shift if the ringgit moves.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Malaysian heritage tourism city priced below Kuala Lumpur, with a small premium in the historic old town for bars and guesthouses. Food anchors are based on the aggregated Malacca estimates (budget meal about MYR 10 to 14, mid-range three-course meal for two about MYR 88 to 100, draught beer about MYR 8 to 12 for a standard serving, cappuccino about MYR 9 to 12). Cocktail and wine use Kuala Lumpur and hotel menu benchmarks and the local beer relationship (cocktail about 3x beer, wine glass about 2.8x beer). Accommodation is a general-knowledge model estimate, not based on searched prices.
